description: Review finding CON-6: §10.5 calls RelayServiceAgreements optional, but relays MUST verify access proofs that exist only under an agreement (lens CON). Location: spec/10-relays.md:584 vs :527, :612; ARCHITECTURE.md S7; spec/11-transport.md:48 vs spec/10-relays.md:667, spec/11-transport.md:114, spec/12-security.md:62. Fix: Delete "Both mechanisms are optional extensions" for the agreement and keep PoW optional. Change 11:48 to "per-`channelToken` rate limits (and PoW where the Relay requires it)". Q2 makes PoW optional under load, so 11:48's MUST also contradicts the decision. Full text: notes/review/CON-verified.md and notes/review/CON.md.
